severity.$comment: General QA uses Critical/Major/Medium/Low; High/Info additionally allowed for Security-Testing findings (that kit's scale)

severityBranch.$comment: which severity-decision-tree branch fired, e.g. 'tree #3: degradation at scale' — expected when agent-filed

priorityProposed.$comment: true = priority is the agent's PROPOSAL pending owner confirmation (default when agent-set); owner flips to false on triage

evidence.$comment: links: sheet tabs, result files, screenshots, run docs

invariantViolated.$comment: per Test-Oracles: every bug implies an invariant — reference or create one

status.$comment: internal QA lifecycle — independent of the team board's workflow state (see boardStatus)

layer.$comment: defect layer; drives the tracker subject prefix: app → [BUG-App], backend → [BUG-BE], frontend-web → [BUG-FE] (no layer → [BUG])

boardStatus.$comment: team tracker/board workflow state (Redmine board + Bug Reports v2 tab column D dropdown) — separate vocabulary from the internal status field

escapedFromCycle.$comment: release/cycle id this bug escaped from (production-found bugs only) — feeds the escape-rate metric
